description: Favorite GitHub Copilot prompt templates for this project.

prompts.name: refactor-legacy-to-react
prompts.title: Refactor legacy JS to React component
prompts.description: Convert a chunk of legacy DOM-manipulation code into a small, focused React functional component with hooks.
prompts.template:
Refactor the following legacy JavaScript (from legacy/sudoku.js) into a React functional component using TypeScript and hooks. Replace DOM manipulation (getElementById, innerHTML) with React state/JSX, preserve existing game logic exactly, and follow this repo's ES6+/TypeScript best practices:

{{code}}

prompts.name: extract-custom-hook
prompts.title: Extract logic into a custom hook
prompts.description: Pull stateful logic out of a component into a reusable custom hook.
prompts.template:
Extract the state and side-effect logic from this component into a custom hook named use{{HookName}}. Keep the component presentational, use TypeScript with explicit types, and add tests following this repo's existing *.test.tsx conventions:

{{code}}

prompts.name: write-unit-tests
prompts.title: Write unit tests for a module
prompts.description: Generate Vitest + Testing Library tests matching the repo's existing test style.
prompts.template:
Write Vitest unit tests for the following module/component, matching the style of existing *.test.ts(x) files in this repo (arrange/act/assert, descriptive it() names, edge cases covered). Do not use fake timers with userEvent clicks; prefer fireEvent wrapped in act():

{{code}}

prompts.name: explain-sudoku-algorithm
prompts.title: Explain a sudoku algorithm
prompts.description: Ask Copilot to explain the logic/complexity of a sudoku solver/generator function.
prompts.template:
Explain what this function does step by step, including its time complexity and any edge cases or failure modes (e.g. backtracking blowups):

{{code}}

prompts.name: add-tailwind-styling
prompts.title: Add Tailwind styling to a component
prompts.description: Apply mobile-first Tailwind utility classes to an existing component.
prompts.template:
Add Tailwind CSS utility classes to style this component, following a mobile-first approach with responsive prefixes (sm:, md:, lg:). Use cn() for conditional classes and avoid custom CSS:

{{code}}

prompts.name: code-review
prompts.title: Review a diff for best practices
prompts.description: Request a review of a diff against this repo's coding standards.
prompts.template:
Review the following diff against this repo's coding standards (ES6+ syntax, strict TypeScript, functional React components, Tailwind-only styling). Point out violations and suggest concrete fixes:

{{diff}}
